title: The Monthly meeting of the club
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：monthly　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 monthly 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the driver wrote of ① a monthly meeting of the club in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② so monthly that nobody in the station would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the monthly ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the monthly meeting of the club that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too monthly to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the monthly ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a monthly payment for the room, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as monthly as the payment for the room they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was monthly or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something monthly, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite monthly; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the monthly ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, in silence, she wrote of another monthly meeting of the club in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less monthly than anybody had expected. ⑩ The monthly payment for the room that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the monthly ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 每月（前置定语 a monthly meeting of the club：1991 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件每月的月会）
B. adj. 每月／按月（两处加强说法：so monthly that … 与 no less monthly than …）
C. adj. 每月／按月（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 每月（表语 too monthly to do：母亲觉得它太每月，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 按月（前置定语 a monthly payment for the room：叔叔把整件事称作一桩按月的房租）
F. adj. 按月（同级比较 as monthly as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩每月的房租相比）
G. adj. 按月（后置定语 something monthly：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 按月（受程度副词修饰 quite monthly：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a monthly meeting of the club
the monthly meeting of the club that
a monthly payment for the room
The monthly payment for the room that

answers.why: monthly 意为“每月”，1991 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件每月的月会”，此处作前置定语 a monthly meeting of the club。
monthly 意为“每月”，此处用 so monthly that 结构，说它每月到车站里没人敢靠近。
monthly 意为“每月”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的每月俱乐部的月会，等于最高级的说法。
monthly 意为“每月”，母亲认为这件东西“太每月了，谁也用不上”，too monthly to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
monthly 意为“按月”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩按月的房租”，此处作前置定语 a monthly payment for the room。
monthly 意为“按月”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩每月的房租一样按月”，同级比较用 as monthly as。
monthly 意为“按月”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“按月的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something monthly。
monthly 意为“按月”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当按月”，quite 修饰原级 monthly。
monthly 意为“按月”，no less monthly than 表示“其按月不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之按月不亚于任何人的预料。
monthly 意为“按月”，母亲 2003 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的按月房租”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件每月的月会。（a monthly meeting of the club）
它每月到车站里没有一个人敢靠近。（so monthly that …）
母亲觉得它太每月，谁也用不上。（too monthly to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩按月的房租。（a monthly payment for the room）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩每月的房租一样按月。（as monthly as …）
到了 1998 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件按月的东西。（something monthly）
answers: In 1991 the driver wrote of a monthly meeting of the club in the timetable.
It was so monthly that nobody in the station would go near it.
My mother thought it too monthly to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a monthly payment for the room.
He said nobody would call it as monthly as the payment for the room they had once had.
By 1998 the timetable asked for nothing but something monthly.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 monthly 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the driver wrote of a monthly meeting of the club in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the monthly meeting of the club that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too monthly to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a monthly payment for the room, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite monthly, and everybody laughed.
The monthly ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
